ruleset.name: OpenDTV Java
ruleset.description:
OpenDTV's PMD ruleset: the PMD quickstart set minus two rules whose advice conflicts with deliberate decisions in this codebase.
ControlStatementBraces - the codebase uses single-statement bodies without braces in ~1,100 places. That is the adopted style; a codebase-wide reformat would be a 30k-line diff with no functional change, and the one measured attempt lowered the project score.
AvoidUsingVolatile - the flagged fields are single-writer driver/UI handshake flags (USB reader status, pipe filter, caption probe counters). volatile is the correct minimal tool there; atomics would add cost and concurrency risk without changing behaviour.
Everything else from quickstart stays on, including unused imports/fields, empty bodies, redundant qualifications and dangling javadoc.
